ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

2. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 5

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 17
   C. 31
   D. 25

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

5. Solve for x: x + 6 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 14
   C. 8
   D. 9

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

7. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

8. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

9. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 5
   D. 37

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 49

13. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 16

14. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

16. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

2. Substitute values: 5² = 5 × 5
3. 5² = 25
Final Answer: 25
